_what: Vendor-price PROVENANCE for packages/cost/src/media.ts. Every string under `vendor` is verbatim from fal's own catalog API — nothing here is paraphrased or secondary-sourced unless `confidence` says so. media.test.ts asserts the shipped price tables agree with `rates`/`rate` field for field, so a table edit without a fresh vendor read shows up as a RED test, and a real price change shows up as a diff with the vendor's own words next to it.
_how_to_refresh: GET https://fal.ai/api/models?keywords={wan-25|inworld|scribe|schnell}&page=1 (unauthenticated, machine-readable) and copy `pricingInfoOverride` / `billingMessage` / `status` / `deprecated` / `removed` for each id below. The same read is the free endpoint-health check for the `-preview` rename risk. Procedure: docs/playbooks/media.md § Reconciliation.

vendor.pricingInfoOverride: Your request will cost **$0.05** per second for **480p**, **$0.10** per second for **720p**, **$0.15** per second for **1080p**.

entries.notes: A `-preview` endpoint that has NOT been renamed or retired as of the read date. Its `image-to-video` sibling carries an identical pricing string. The OpenAPI input schema defaults `resolution` to "1080p" — 3x the 480p figure — which is why the adapter pins it explicitly. `duration` is a STRING enum ["5","10"], default "5".

vendor.pricingInfoOverride: Your request will cost **$0.01** per 1000 character.

entries.notes: Billed on submitted input, so a voice take is priceable BEFORE it exists — the reason this model is in and per-generated-second models are out. Input schema: `text`, `voice` (closed enum), `sample_rate_hertz` (enum, default 48000). No pace/stretch knob is exposed, which is the point (delta pitfall 15).

vendor.pricingInfoOverride: Your request will cost **$0.008 per input audio minutes**. If keyterm is used, you request will cost %30 more.

entries.notes: SURCHARGE: the vendor string states +30% when keyterms are used. We submit `keyterms: []` and must NOT start sending them without re-pricing this row to $0.0104/min. Input schema: `audio_url`, `keyterms` (default []), `diarize`, `tag_audio_events`, `language_code`.

entries.unit: USD per WHOLE megapixel, rounded UP

vendor.billingMessage: Images are billed by rounding up to the nearest megapixel.

entries.notes: The ROUNDING RULE is vendor-direct; the $0.003 figure is NOT — this entry exposes no `pricingInfoOverride`, so the number is secondary-sourced and stays MEDIUM until an invoice reconciles it (docs/playbooks/media.md § Reconciliation). `fal-ai/flux-1/schnell` exists with the identical billing message. Input schema takes `image_size` (preset name OR {width,height}) and `num_images` (default 1, a straight price MULTIPLIER) — both pinned by the adapter.
